graph_meta.description: Thematic AI CapEx & Counterparty Circularity Directed Weighted Network

nodes.label: Amazon (AWS)
nodes.q3_2026_note: Direct owned Trainium/Bedrock infrastructure captures full 38.5% EBIT margin on Anthropic ARR ($164.7B) with zero neo-cloud margin leakage.

nodes.label: Alphabet (GCP)
nodes.q3_2026_note: Triple-CapEx penalty: simultaneously funding internal TPU v5/v6 with Broadcom, buying direct Nvidia clusters, and leasing $12.5B in CoreWeave capacity, paying neo-cloud debt tolls.

nodes.label: Microsoft (Azure)
nodes.q3_2026_note: Captures $65B+ ARR from OpenAI on Azure Supercomputing clusters; elevated depreciation exposure on multi-gigawatt Stargate buildouts.

nodes.label: Meta Platforms
nodes.q3_2026_note: Zero direct enterprise cloud ARR recapture; commoditizes frontier model pricing by releasing open-weights (Llama), accelerating token deflation for labs.

nodes.label: Anthropic, PBC
nodes.q3_2026_note: Carries $265.6B nominal compute take-or-pay commitments ($485.3B capitalized debt, $23.5B imputed interest) to AWS and GCP; cash burn funded by equity.

nodes.label: OpenAI
nodes.q3_2026_note: Contractually bound to Azure; consuming billions in discounted compute while operating at heavy cash deficits.

nodes.label: CoreWeave
nodes.q3_2026_note: Pledges H100 clusters as collateral for $10.5B debt; marks up GPU compute instances to Google and Microsoft to cover $1.15B annual debt service.

nodes.label: Private Credit Debt Syndicate
nodes.q3_2026_note: Blackstone, Magnetar, Coatue providing senior secured asset-backed loans at SOFR + 750 bps; vulnerable to GPU collateral liquidation haircut.

nodes.label: Nvidia Corp
nodes.q3_2026_note: Absorbs ~55-60% of all hyperscaler and neo-cloud compute CapEx at 75% gross margins; zero outbound customer equity debt claims.

nodes.label: Broadcom Inc
nodes.q3_2026_note: Sole co-designer of Google TPU v5/v6 and AWS Trainium 2 ASICs; captures $18.5B in high-margin custom silicon and Tomahawk switching.

nodes.label: Taiwan Semiconductor (TSMC)
nodes.q3_2026_note: Monopolistic fabrication for Nvidia GPUs and Broadcom ASICs; exclusive CoWoS packaging capacity bottleneck through 2027.

nodes.label: Powell Industries
nodes.q3_2026_note: $2.4B record backlog in substation switchgear and PCRs for 100MW+ data center grids; fortress balance sheet with $634M net cash and zero debt.

edges.label: Amazon Equity / Convertible Investment
edges.mechanism: Cash equity and note commitments anchoring Anthropic primary capitalization.

edges.label: Anthropic Contractual Compute Recapture
edges.mechanism: Note 13 unconditional take-or-pay cloud reservations on AWS Trainium/EC2 clusters.

edges.label: Google Equity / Sidecar Investment
edges.mechanism: Co-investment in Anthropic Series and $26.0B IPO private sidecar.

edges.label: Anthropic GCP Cloud Recapture
edges.mechanism: Note 13 commitments allocated to Google Cloud TPU and GPU instances.

edges.label: Microsoft Equity & Compute Financing
edges.mechanism: Stargate joint venture and Azure exclusive hosting rights.

edges.label: OpenAI Azure Recapture ARR
edges.mechanism: Azure infrastructure consumption agreements for GPT-4/o1 training and inference.

edges.label: GCP Neo-Cloud Capacity Lease (Leakage)
edges.mechanism: Google contracts overflow GPU capacity from CoreWeave; pays markup covering CoreWeave debt service, dragging GCP margins.

edges.label: Asset-Backed GPU Debt Facility
edges.mechanism: Blackstone/Magnetar loan syndicate secured by H100 chips; CoreWeave must generate positive cash flow or face foreclosure.

edges.label: CoreWeave GPU Cluster Hardware Outflow
edges.mechanism: CoreWeave converts debt proceeds into Nvidia H100 and Blackwell server purchases.

edges.label: Nvidia Strategic Preferred Allocation Equity
edges.mechanism: Vendor preferred allocation: Nvidia invests token equity to guarantee preferred delivery access.

edges.label: AWS Nvidia Accelerator Outflow
edges.mechanism: DGX SuperPOD and Blackwell purchases for AWS EC2 UltraClusters.

edges.label: Google Cloud Nvidia Hardware Outflow
edges.mechanism: A3/A4 supercomputer clusters for Gemini training and customer hosting.

edges.label: Azure Nvidia Hardware Outflow
edges.mechanism: Primary GPU cluster procurement for OpenAI infrastructure and Azure AI.

edges.label: Meta Nvidia Mega-Cluster Outflow
edges.mechanism: 350k+ H100 equivalent cluster deployments for open-source Llama model series.

edges.label: TPU v5/v6 Co-Design Silicon Outflow
edges.mechanism: Custom ASIC NRE and volume purchase for Google Trillium TPU architectures.

edges.label: AWS Trainium / Inferentia ASIC Outflow
edges.mechanism: Custom silicon co-design and PCIe switching for Annapurna Labs chips.

edges.label: Leading-Edge Wafer & CoWoS Packaging
edges.mechanism: TSMC 4N/3nm wafer supply and advanced CoWoS interposer bottleneck allocation.

edges.label: Custom ASIC Sub-3nm Wafer Outflow
edges.mechanism: TSMC 3nm foundry capacity for Google and AWS custom accelerator dies.

edges.label: Substation Switchgear & PCR Megasites
edges.mechanism: Powell Industries medium-voltage switchgear for multi-gigawatt AWS data centers.

edges.label: Utility Interconnects & Switchgear
edges.mechanism: Custom power control rooms solving utility connection queues for Azure AI.

edges.label: Data Center Power Infrastructure
edges.mechanism: Substation electrical equipment for Google data center campus expansions.

edges.label: Modular Substation PCRs
edges.mechanism: Powell medium-voltage power distribution gear for Meta AI supercluster sites.

edges.label: Neo-Cloud High-Density Power Rooms
edges.mechanism: Substation switchgear for CoreWeave colocation facility energization.

edges.label: Azure Overflow Capacity Rental
edges.mechanism: Microsoft contracts secondary cluster capacity from CoreWeave to buffer OpenAI peaks.
